clips.title: The story
paras: The Dark Iron Ambassador is an emissary of the Dark Iron clan found deep within Gnomeregan. His presence raises questions about the clan's interest in the ruined gnome capital.
The Dark Iron Ambassador is found among the dangers of irradiated Gnomeregan. He represents the Dark Iron clan, but the purpose of his mission is not explained.
